description: Ranks the countries that best fit a person who wants to move abroad ("where should I live?", "where should I move next?", "best country for me as a remote worker"). Same algorithm and data as the MyNomadWorld quiz: tax the user would actually pay, cost of living versus where they live, safety, climate, sea, flight time to family, language, healthcare, ease of residency. Extra filters: digital nomad visa, minimum internet speed, time zone overlap. Returns the top matches with reasons, watch-outs and links.

climate.description: Wanted climates (any of them). warm = average 17 C or more, mild = 9 to 24 C, cold = 15 C or less. Empty = climate does not matter.

current_country.description: Country the user lives in now, if different. Cost and current tax are compared with this one, and it is left out of the results.

home_country.description: Country the user is from (English name or ISO code). Distance to family and language are measured from here. Required.

household.description: Who is moving: alone, with a partner, or with children.

max_hours_difference.description: Maximum hours of difference from work_timezone_utc_offset (default 3 when an offset is given).

min_internet_mbps.description: Minimum fixed broadband speed in Mbps (approximate national median).

monthly_income_eur.description: Monthly income in euros before tax. Used to estimate the income tax the user would pay in each country.

needs_digital_nomad_visa.description: Only countries with a digital nomad or remote-work visa in our data (and, if income is given, whose income requirement the user meets).

priorities.description: Ordered list, most important first. Values: tax (low taxes), cost (low cost of living), safety, near (close to home and family), lang (they speak my language), life (healthcare and long life expectancy).

residency_budget_eur.description: Money available for a residency deposit or investment. Hides countries whose minimum is higher.

sea.description: coast = only countries with a coastline; near = sea is a plus; any = does not matter.

work_timezone_utc_offset.description: UTC offset of the team or clients the user works with, for example -5 for New York in winter or 1 for Berlin.

name: recommend_countries
title: Recommend countries to move to
